sources.snippet: Nanbeige4.1-3B is a unified generalist language model with 3 billion parameters, developed by Nanbeige LLM Lab (the AI research arm of BOSS Zhipin). Released in February 2026, the model represents an enhanced iteration of the Nanbeige4 series, specifically optimized to bridge the gap between small-scale efficiency and large-scale reasoning capability.
